subject: Customer-specific audit window: scoped erase playbook request & SOC 2 control mapping
messages:
From: Sarah Johnson <sarah.johnson@mednova.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@mednova.com>, security@mednova.com
Date: 2027-07-10T16:12:00-07:00
Subject: Scoped erase / audit artifacts request for tenant MN-472

Hi Stephanie,

During our upcoming SOC 2 readiness review we need a short package describing how Redwood would handle a customer-scoped log deletion request for a subset of tenant traces. Specifically MedNova needs: 
- A short playbook describing steps to perform a selective deletion (criteria: tenant_id MN-472, sessionID prefix MN-47-), including controls that prevent collateral data loss.
- Evidence artifacts we can provide to our auditors: deletion manifest, immutable proof-of-delete hashes (if available), and a mapping of the SOC 2 controls that this flow satisfies.

We don't need an exhaustive suite — just enough to demonstrate repeatability and control coverage for the handful of tenant traces we plan to request be deleted as part of a data minimization exercise. Can you confirm what artifacts Redwood can provide and an estimated delivery timeline?

Thanks,
Sarah
Sarah Johnson
Head of Security & Compliance
MedNova

--
Note: we may ask for a temporary hold on related debug snapshots until auditors validate the deletion path.
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Johnson <sarah.johnson@mednova.com>
Cc: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@mednova.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-07-10T17:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Scoped erase / audit artifacts request for tenant MN-472

Hi Sarah — thanks for the clear ask. We can produce a scoped erase playbook plus a compact evidence bundle that maps to SOC 2 CC6/CC7 (change management / system operations) and the SIG/CAIQ items you commonly see for data lifecycle.

What we'll deliver (proposed):
1) mednova_scoped_erase_playbook_v1.pdf — step-by-step runnable checklist (roles, gating approvals, verification steps)
2) forensic_delete_log_20270701-20270710.csv — deletion manifest with timestamps, operator IDs, and per-object digests
3) soc2_control_mapping_mednova.csv — mapping between playbook steps and SOC 2 control criteria (short-form)
4) caiq_answers_mednova.pdf — the subset of CAIQ answers relevant to retention/erase flows

Timeline: we can assemble a draft bundle within 2 business days (EOD 2027-07-12) and provide a signed attestation + immutable manifest export within 5 business days, assuming no unusual legal holds. If you'd like, we can also include a short video walkthrough for your auditors.

Attachments: stubbed in this reply — final artifacts will be shared via secure Drive link and hashed ZIP.

I'll kick off coordination with infra to export the deletion manifests and with Priyom to produce the SOC 2 mapping. Ben — can you confirm we have the immutable digest export for deletes in place for the requested window?

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Head of Compliance Programs
Redwood Inference

---
Attachment stubs: mednova_scoped_erase_playbook_v1.pdf (draft), soc2_control_mapping_mednova.csv (draft)
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-07-10T17:28:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Scoped erase / audit artifacts request for tenant MN-472

Stephanie / Priyom — forwarding Sarah's request. Quick notes from infra: we can produce deletion manifests with sha256 digests for objects (we generate digests during purge pipeline), but immutable proof (witnessing to an external ledger) is not enabled by default. We do have tamper-evident logs in S3 (WORM) for the audit window and audit trails in the internal retention ledger.

Questions for the playbook:
- Do we need an operator signature flow (DocuSign) per deletion or is a centralized attestation acceptable? MedNova auditors sometimes prefer per-request signatures.
- Are we excluding debugging snapshots that are kept for X days (they may be on a separate retention bucket)? If so, we need to document the hold/unhold steps.

Action items:
- Priyom: generate the manifest export for 2027-07-01 through 2027-07-10 for tenant MN-472 (include object_id, path prefix, delete_ts, operator_id, sha256) and confirm storage location.
- Priyom: help Stephanie map playbook steps to SOC 2 criteria; I'll provide the infra-side notes for CC6/CC7 controls.

Ben
Sr. Product Ops
Redwood Inference

On Jul 10, 2027, at 16:12, Sarah Johnson <sarah.johnson@mednova.com> wrote:
> (original message quoted)
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Johnson <sarah.johnson@mednova.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-07-11T10:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Scoped erase / audit artifacts request for tenant MN-472

Hi Sarah / team — quick update and delivery plan.

Attached: forensic_delete_log_20270701-20270710.csv (exported, contains object_id, path, delete_ts, operator_id, sha256). The export was pulled from the purge ledger, and we've placed a hashed ZIP in a secured Drive folder (link below).

We also attached an initial draft playbook (mednova_scoped_erase_playbook_v1.pdf) and a short mapping file (soc2_control_mapping_mednova.csv). The CAIQ subset is included as caiq_answers_mednova.pdf. All artifacts are drafts; final versions will include a one-line signed attestation and a manifest with a timestamped S3 object created after signature to serve as the immutable witness for auditors.

Drive link (secure): https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/1A2b3C_mednova-evidence

Notes & caveats:
- Debug snapshots: excluded from the current manifest because they're retained in a separate bucket with a 14-day TTL. If MedNova needs those included in the audit, we can freeze that bucket and include a special extraction (will add 2 business days).
- Operator signature: we can support per-request DocuSign flow. If you want per-deletion signatures we'll need to schedule a brief ops window to enable the webhook binding.

Next steps:
1) Confirm you received the Drive link and artifacts.
2) Let us know if you need debug snapshots included or if the separate attestation format is acceptable.
3) We will produce the final signed attestation and immutable manifest by EOD 2027-07-15 if no holds requested.

Thanks — Priyom
Security & Compliance Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachments included: mednova_scoped_erase_playbook_v1.pdf, forensic_delete_log_20270701-20270710.csv, soc2_control_mapping_mednova.csv, caiq_answers_mednova.pdf
